tolerances.scope: observed room surfaces and task objects; scene-specific requirements remain operator-defined

constraints: Capture and offline validation only; no reconstruction or robot operation.

provenance.notes: Recording code and configuration are in meta/recorder_source. Postprocessor code is separately identified, never substituted for producer provenance.

clocks.synchronization: Host receipt/write and phone decode clock; not exposure time
Unknown absolute offset; retain clock-offset observations and resets

frames.axes: aligned SLAM map, gravity-aligned Z up
X forward, Y left, Z up at exploration zero

calibrations.notes: Device/model, serial, selected lens and mount are unknown. The reference phone profile is unverified, not an operator declaration. Intrinsics, distortion, stabilization/crop, rolling shutter, exposure timing and extrinsics require validation; retained source metadata is in meta/phone_camera.json when available.

transforms.notes: Head-adjacent torso mount photograph is not a measured transform.

alignments.notes: Receipt minus header offsets are diagnostics, not measured one-way latency.

scene_policy.retention_policy: Preserve complete native source runs; no automatic deletion.
scene_policy.notes: No exclusions declared for this capture. Dynamic foreground and ordinary blur are not exclusions.

gaps: Raw metric XYZ, scans and online poses support observed local geometry only.
Moving coverage, deskew timing convention, mount and map-epoch alignment still require validation.
This is input readiness for observed surfaces only; room-scale accuracy tolerances are unspecified.
Native video retained; estimate/validate intrinsics, extrinsics and exposure timing across motion.
Only shared-SLAM internal consistency is supported.
Select exact target and separate repeat queries; independent reference and final-test split absent.
Capture does not qualify grasping, reach, collision geometry or articulated mechanisms.

native_conventions.lidar: XYZ metres. Raw MID-360 time field is relative nanoseconds; bridge scales by 1e-9. Driver scan-stamp reference/deskew unverified. Registered XYZ already transformed; raw sweeps retained.
native_conventions.imu: Raw MID-360 acceleration in g; bridge multiplies by 9.80511. Gyro consumed as rad/s. Empty native frame; physical axes/bias calibration unverified.
native_conventions.poses: Online SLAM T_header_frame_from_child_frame; translation metres, quaternion xyzw. Retain /homebody/slam_epoch; not a globally optimized or independently surveyed trajectory.
native_conventions.joints: Measured robot/hand state; joint ordering and model attachment require validation before self-mask/reach claims.
